title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن يحاضر في موسم الأخوة
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Lectures at the Brotherhood Season
body_ar:
ألقى رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو محاضرة في موسم الأخوة الذي تنظمه جمعية "يدا بيد"،موضوع المحاضرة كان تحت عنوان "التنوع العرقي" وقد بين الشيخ أن الحياة مسرح للصراع بين الحق الباطل وأن حكمة الله سبحانه اقتضت أن تقوم هذه الحياة على التنوع والتفاوت بين الناس ، ولكن هذا التفا وت مؤقت في الحياة الدنيا .

وقد استعرض الشيخ النصوص التي حثت على بناء عرى الأخوة والمحبة بين المسلمين وحذرت بشكل صريح من كل أشكال التقاطع والتنافر سد ا لأي فجوة أوثغرة يدخل منها الشيطان لإثارة الفتن والخلاف بين المؤمنين .

وذكر الشيخ بالإجراءات التي اتخذها الشرع لسلامة المجتمع المسلم من الأخطار والفتن حيث حرم الغيبة والشحناء والظلم واللمز والتنا بز بالألقاب والسخرية سعيا لبقاء الألفة والمحبة بين المسلمين وقطعا للطريق أمام كل دواعي الفتنة والقطيعة. وهذه التوجيهات السا مية هي التي حوتها سورة الحجرات حيث كانت دستورا قام عليه المجتمع المسلم في المدينة المنورة.

وأكد الشيخ على أن هذه الأخوة هي التي اعتمدها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في إقامة الدولة في المدينة حيث بنى المسجد وبعده آخى بين المسلمين حتى كانوا يتوارثون على أساس هذه الأخوة قبل نسخها .

وقد عقب على محاضرة الشيخ محمد الحسن فضيلة الشيخ القاضي بال محمد البشير مؤكدا أن مآل الناس إلى طريقين اثنتين لا ثالث لهما: طريق المتقين وطريق المجرمين والإنسان هو الذي يحددطريقه "إما إلى جنة وإما إلى نار".

للمتابعة اضغط هنا..
body_en:
The president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, delivered a lecture at the Brotherhood Season organised by the 'Hand in Hand' Association. The subject of the lecture was under the title 'Ethnic Diversity'. The Sheikh made clear that life is a stage for the struggle between truth and falsehood, and that the wisdom (ḥikmah) of God, glorified be He, has determined that this life should rest upon diversity and disparity between people — but that this disparity is temporary, belonging to the life of this world.

The Sheikh reviewed the texts that urge the building of the bonds of brotherhood and love between Muslims, and that warn in explicit terms against every form of severance and mutual aversion, so as to close off any gap or breach through which Satan might enter to stir up discord (fitnah) and disagreement among the believers.

The Sheikh recalled the measures that the Sharia has taken for the safety of Muslim society from dangers and discord, in that it has forbidden (ḥarām) backbiting, rancour, injustice, disparagement, the trading of insulting nicknames, and mockery — seeking thereby to preserve familiarity and love between Muslims and to block the way before every occasion of discord and rupture. These lofty directives are what Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt contains, where they were a constitution upon which the Muslim society in Medina the Illuminated was founded.

The Sheikh affirmed that this brotherhood is what the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) relied upon in establishing the state in Medina, in that he built the mosque and after it made a bond of brotherhood between the Muslims — so much so that they used to inherit from one another on the basis of this brotherhood, before it was abrogated (mansūkh).

His Eminence Shaykh al-Qadi Bâ Muhammad al-Bashir commented on Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan's lecture, affirming that people end upon two paths and no third: the path of the God-conscious and the path of the criminals, and that it is the human being who determines his own path — 'either to a garden or to a fire'.

flags.context: وقد بين الشيخ أن الحياة مسرح للصراع بين الحق الباطل
options: the struggle between truth and falsehood (reading a dropped و)
leave the phrase as it stands
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). The conjunction is missing: 'الحق الباطل' should read 'الحق والباطل'. As it stands the Arabic would read 'the false truth', which is plainly not the sense. Translated by the evident sense and flagged; body_ar preserves the source.

flags.arabic: حيث حرم الغيبة والشحناء والظلم واللمز والتنابز بالألقاب والسخرية
flags.context: the measures the Sharia has taken
options: it has forbidden (ḥarām) backbiting, rancour, injustice, disparagement, the trading of insulting nicknames, and mockery
it has prohibited backbiting and the rest
flags.note: حرّم is rendered on the fixed mapping as forbidden (ḥarām). Note that the items listed are the prohibitions of Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt 49:11–12, which the paragraph then names. 'الشحناء' is rancour or mutual hatred rather than a named act; a reviewer may wish to check whether the Sheikh listed it among the forbidden acts or as their consequence, since the reporter's sentence does not distinguish.

flags.context: حتى كانوا يتوارثون على أساس هذه الأخوة قبل نسخها
flags.note: What was abrogated is the inheritance between the emigrants and the helpers on the basis of the bond of brotherhood, not the brotherhood itself; the Arabic pronoun in 'نسخها' is ambiguous between the two. Rendered with the ambiguity preserved. A careless English reading would have the Prophet's bond of brotherhood itself abrogated, which the Sheikh certainly did not say.

flags.context: the commentator Shaykh al-Qadi Bâ Muhammad al-Bashir
options: either to a garden or to a fire
either to Paradise or to the Fire
flags.note: The words are the commentator's, not the Sheikh's, and the source marks them as a quotation without a source. 'Paradise' and 'the Fire' are the established English, and are recommended here; the indefinite Arabic has been kept literally in the body so that nothing is read into a second-hand quotation.

translator_notes: News summary of a lecture on ethnic diversity. Note that everything after the fourth paragraph is a second speaker, and the site must not present it as the Sheikh's. Source defects preserved in body_ar: the dropped conjunction in 'الحق الباطل'; stray spaces inside words ('التفا وت', 'سد ا', 'التنا بز', 'السا مية'); missing spaces at '،موضوع' and 'يحددطريقه'. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
